integrity: Minimality and uniqueness are established by exhaustive enumeration of all Dyck words through length 24. Two independent exact enumeration routes agree, and the witness is separately checked for nesting level and every factor period. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only the first newly attainable nesting level, level 4. It gives no general minimum-length formula for larger nesting levels, and an unindexed computation could in principle duplicate the finite classification.
title: The shortest nesting-four Dyck word at the exact \(7/3\) repetition boundary
